objective: Verify agentkit 1.0.2 and the complete skill portfolio after adding durable full slash-command examples to every canonical skill README.
change_class: documentation-only command examples plus deterministic README generation

acceptance.readme_coverage: 48/48 canonical skills have adjacent README.md files with full command examples and expected results
acceptance.private_visibility: package-private examples invoke the owning public parent and reject direct slash invocation
acceptance.donor_lock: 10/10 agentkit donors and 12/12 metaskillpack donors match canonical versions and hashes
acceptance.structure: repository, marketplace, registry and package validators pass
acceptance.behavior: existing routing and behavior suites remain unchanged and pass
acceptance.portability: 43 selective packages and one aggregate package reproduce canonical skill contents
acceptance.lifecycle: versions, registry hashes, marketplace release and rollback state agree

execution_policy.side_effects: repository files and generated package staging only
execution_policy.rollback: Git revert to marketplace release 3.7.0 and agentkit 1.0.1
